title: Governing Law of an Arbitration Agreement - teaching pattern

content.body: Educational hypothetical, not an official statutory illustration and not a new decided case. Use only the law already recorded in this topic file. Facts already recorded in this topic file: The Court considered arbitrability and the role of the referral court. Issue already recorded: When should a court refer parties to arbitration and which disputes are non-arbitrable? Recorded ingredient used: Governing Law of an Arbitration Agreement sits within ADR & Arbitration and is governed by Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996; Mediation Act, 2023; Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987. Explain the legal mischief, institutional purpose and constitutional value before applyin... Application: a person affected by Governing Law of an Arbitration Agreement places only those recorded facts before the forum already named in this file. Match each recorded ingredient. Where every recorded ingredient is present, the recorded rule applies and the result stops at that rule. Authority already recorded in this file, not a new citation: Vidya Drolia v. Durga Trading Corporation (2021) 2 SCC 1. Use it only as already written here.
